symptom: Unity 2022.3.62f2 fails AssemblyShadowDemo.EditorTests compilation with CS0234 before M07FixedByteBootstrapPolicyTests can execute.
directIssue: M07FixedByteBootstrapPolicyTests.cs directly imports HybridCLR.AssemblyShadow.CodeGen, but AssemblyShadowDemo.EditorTests.asmdef does not reference the defining assembly Unity.HybridCLR.AssemblyShadow.CodeGen.
rootCause: Unity asmdef dependencies are not transitive. HybridCLR.Editor references Unity.HybridCLR.AssemblyShadow.CodeGen, but that does not expose CodeGen types to AssemblyShadowDemo.EditorTests. The captured C# response references HybridCLR.Editor.ref.dll and the new test source but contains no CodeGen assembly reference.
designGap: Primary bounded Python tests inspect the source/layout but do not compile the new Unity test assembly. The candidate asmdef was unchanged when the test was added.
impact: M07FixedByteBootstrapPolicyTests were initially blocked, then passed 2/2 after the bounded local fix
V02-V05 blocked/not run because post-fix source authority fails closed
No post-mutation M07 restoration acceptance or successful M07/runtime/performance chain
recommendedDirection: Review and retain the bounded direct asmdef reference.
Publish a new source anchor/source pin/source-target/handoff that authenticates the asmdef bytes.
Rerun fresh V00-V05; V04 must still exercise a controlled failure after mutation and the full successful M07/runtime/performance chain.
localAction: Added the single direct Unity.HybridCLR.AssemblyShadow.CodeGen reference to AssemblyShadowDemo.EditorTests.asmdef. Candidate Unity compile then passed with zero errors and M07FixedByteBootstrapPolicyTests passed 2/2 in real Unity. No policy, allowlist, runtime, protected pin, or product behavior changed.
uncertainty: The local fix proves compilation and both policy tests. Because source authority intentionally fails closed afterward, no V02/V03 acceptance builds were run. The controlled wrapper failure occurred before Unity mutation and does not replace the required post-mutation restoration proof or normal M07 chain.
remainingBlocker: The authoritative source anchor and source-pin bytes do not include the bounded local asmdef fix. The committed preflight correctly fails closed on the modified asmdef, so V02-V05 cannot be accepted until Primary reviews/publishes the new source identity and matching handoff.
diagnosticControlledFailure: The outer M07 wrapper was exercised with the known non-candidate installed runtime. It failed at the initial pinned-runtime check and emitted ExactBytesRestored for all three owned files. Their before-restore hashes equaled their originals, so this proves the failure path and receipt but provides no mutation-restoration coverage.
